metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected using a 14-channel EMOTIV EPOC X headset while participants viewed six marketing video stimuli from three companies, categorized as traditional versus extreme advertisement styles.

citation_details.title: EEG dataset on consumer responses to extreme versus traditional marketing videos
citation_details.author: Allison Edit, Attila Pohlmann
citation_details.abstract: This dataset contains EEG recordings from ten participants exposed to six marketing video stimuli from three companies (Red Bull, GoPro, and Columbia Sportswear). Videos were categorized as either traditional product-focused advertisements or extreme, authentic documentary-style content, enabling investigation of consumer neural responses to different marketing strategies. The dataset supports research in neuromarketing and consumer neuroscience.
